newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, minor berth congestion.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, minor berth congestion.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Monday despite weak demand as minor berth congestion prevented suppliers from lifting cargoes, traders said.
The congestion prevented Singapore bunker levels from falling when overall sentiment was weak in this region, they said.
However, "demand is still pretty poor, especially on Monday," said one supplier.
Majors quoted the 380-cst grade at around $97/$99 per tonne and the 180-cst at $103-$105. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $188 and $198 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
